Jharkhand Politician Sudivya Kumar, Aide to Hemant Soren, Dies

Sudivya Kumar, described as a key aide and "crisis manager" for the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) and Chief Minister Hemant Soren, has died. He was known for his long involvement in Jharkhand's political landscape, spanning over three and a half decades. His career included participation in the Jharkhand movement and organizational politics within the JMM. He was considered a close associate of Hemant Soren, likened to an elder brother.
